policy.scope: Checkpoint A only; no Cargo launch backend admitted

disk_monitor_risk.semantics: 100ms sampled allocated-block growth and real statvfs free bytes, not a hard aggregate quota. Qualification simulations use <=8MiB test output; 2MiB growth /4MiB virtual free thresholds are stricter TEST ONLY.

policy.guardian_death_prerequisite: Exact same-implementation normal handoff proof with complete owned-tree cleanup must pass before pidfd SIGKILL injection
policy.metric: RLIMIT_AS is virtual address space, not RSS; cgroup memory.max is aggregate tree accounting

approval.scope: Checkpoint A new small fault tests only
approval.authorizer: Direct human reply in this chat
approval.reply: 仅批准上述新增小型测试
